name: Field Dok
body:
Price 3,600 gp; Slot back; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This heavy duty metal framed backpack is constructed from rugged dark green waterproofed canvas and has multiple straps securing it about the shoulders and waist, but what is most noticeable is the long articulated metal arm extending straight up from the top of the pack that curves down to about waist level ending with a set of pincers adorned with hypodermic needles, shears, or rolled bandage dispensers. The pack functions as a handy haversack and the arm functions like an alchemist’s Vestigial Arm.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,800 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells secret chest
